props.name: entity_types
props.meaning: Types to search. Several make the picker polymorphic.

props.name: context
props.meaning: The widget context. Every read goes through it, so widgets on a page share one cache.

props.name: value
props.meaning: The chosen row. Two-way in Svelte.

props.name: label_field
props.meaning: Field holding the row label.

props.name: search_fields
props.meaning: Fields matched on top of the display-name chain. A function is called with the query.

props.name: secondary_field
props.meaning: Field shown right-aligned, drawn by its data type. A resolved column renders it by type.

props.name: secondary
props.meaning: Right-aligned text of your own. Wins over `secondaryField`.

props.name: sub_label_field
props.meaning: Field shown under the label. A resolved column renders it by type.

props.name: sub_label
props.default: the type, when several are searched
props.meaning: Computes the sub-label.

props.name: thumbnail
props.meaning: Field holding the thumbnail URL. `false` hides the leading slot.

props.name: round_thumbnail
props.meaning: Draws the thumbnail as a circle.

props.name: show_code
props.meaning: Shows the row's `code` beside the label when the two differ.

props.name: site_url
props.meaning: The site the status sprite is served from, for a secondary that is a status.

props.name: fields
props.meaning: Extra fields to request.

props.name: filters
props.meaning: Pre-filter, merged into every search with `and`.

props.name: project_id
props.meaning: Scopes to one project.

props.name: exclude
props.meaning: Rows kept out of the results.

props.name: min_query_length
props.meaning: Under it the query carries no name condition.

props.name: page_size
props.meaning: Rows a page, with a load more row under them.

props.name: debounce_ms
props.meaning: Wait after the last keystroke before searching.

props.name: size
props.meaning: Control height: 7, 8 and 9.

props.name: readonly
props.meaning: Keeps full contrast and drops the affordances.

props.name: invalid
props.meaning: Sets `aria-invalid` and the destructive ring.

props.name: clearable
props.meaning: Shows the clear control.

props.name: placeholder
props.meaning: Shown in the control while nothing is chosen.

props.name: search_placeholder
props.meaning: Shown in the query input once something is chosen.

props.name: open
props.meaning: Whether the popup is showing. Two-way in Svelte.

props.name: empty_label
props.meaning: Shown when a query matches nothing.

props.name: loading_label
props.meaning: Names the skeletons a read stands behind, for a screen reader.

props.name: error_label
props.meaning: Shown in place of what the failed read said.

events.name: value_changed
events.when: A row was chosen, or the clear control was pressed.

events.name: error
events.when: A read failed. The list shows it inline as well.

events.name: open_changed
events.when: The popup opened or closed. Svelte also binds it with `bind:open`.

keyboard.does: Opens the list and searches the server.
On the chevron, opens the list.
Moves the highlight through the rows and keeps it in view, including across a load more page. The last row holds it rather than wrapping.
Moves the highlight, and the list scrolls it into view.
Chooses the highlighted row, or loads the next page on the load more row.
Closes the list and clears the query. On a closed picker it does nothing.
In an empty search box, clears the value.
On a chip, walks the row. `ArrowRight` past the last chip returns to the input.
On a chip, removes it and leaves the caret on its neighbour.
Moves to the clear control, then the chevron, then out.
